statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient reports recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The episodes of dizziness and giddiness are difficult to characterize in duration or frequency
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
